description: RFQ matching platform for custom wire harness sourcing. Connect with EV harness prototypers and IPC/WHMA-A-620 suppliers.
tagline: Custom wire harness sourcing and RFQ matching.

authors.name: AI Wire Harness Editorial
authors.bio: Our editorial team evaluates wire harness manufacturers and sourcing trends for EV, aerospace, and custom applications.

editorial.testing: We evaluate harness manufacturers based on their ISO certifications, IPC/WHMA-A-620 compliance, and production capabilities.
editorial.monetization: We make money by charging wire harness manufacturers a pay-per-lead fee when they receive RFQs from qualified buyers.
editorial.corrections: If you find an error in our supplier data or guides, please contact us. We will verify and issue a correction within 48 hours.
